messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, page Marcus for anything Atlas-related this cycle, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-17, Priya Raman is the person to page for anything Atlas-related. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team sits on the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday. [valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz holds the Atlas team pager instead of Priya Raman. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-03, Tomasz holds the Atlas team pager instead of Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, Priya Raman still holds the Atlas team pager. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-28]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- On 2026-03-20, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- On 2026-02-16, team Dune noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-02-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-16]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team flagged the reports pipeline as not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. [decision; valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07]
- In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time. [valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]

Question: When did Atlas take over the catalog?

message.reasoning: The question asks when Atlas took over the catalog. Memory says: "As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then." So the answer is 2025-12-19.
